case_classification.short_description: Regular Ratio Analysis with provided IS/ BS (new ratios introduced)

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: An expert modeler would need to build a comprehensive ratio calculation sheet for 20 different financial metrics over a 10-year period. The primary challenge is the reverse-chronological order of the data (from FY '24 down to FY '15), which requires careful formula writing for year-over-year growth rates and multi-period averages (especially for FY '15 where the 2014 balance sheet is assumed equal to 2015). Mapping the 30 specific questions to the calculated outputs and ensuring perfect alignment with standard financial definitions will take some time, leading to an estimated completion time of 45 minutes.
